title: feat: add JSON POST support for 3D
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Introduces a new POST /3d/{prompt} API surface for JSON model, image, resolution, and seed parameters.
- Reuses the existing 3D authentication, safety, provider routing, billing, and response path.
- Bypasses URL-only media caching for POST while keeping GET behavior unchanged.

Tests:
- npm test --workspace pollinations-gen
- npm run typecheck --workspace pollinations-gen
- npx vitest run test/model3d

gist.headline: 3D Takes JSON Orders
gist.blurb: The 3D endpoint now accepts a proper JSON POST request, because prompts occasionally travel with more luggage than a URL can reasonably carry. Same 3D pipeline, more room for the useful knobs.
gist.summary: Added POST /3d/{prompt} support for JSON body parameters including model, image, resolution, and seed, while reusing the existing 3D auth, safety, provider routing, billing, and response flow.
gist.impact: Developers can now create 3D generations with structured POST payloads for model selection, reference images, resolution, and reproducible seeds, while existing GET requests keep their current behavior.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny 3D sculptor in a cozy garden workshop, feeding a neatly labeled JSON scroll into a retro terminal that produces a small pastel voxel sculpture. The terminal represents the new POST API surface; floating pixel tiles labeled model, image, resolution, and seed show the structured controls, while code-plants and flowers keep the scene rooted in the hive.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of the pollinations bee mascot with a tiny sculptor beret and tool belt feeding a glowing JSON scroll into a retro CRT terminal, which is printing a small pastel 3D voxel flower sculpture; floating pixel labels read “model”, “image”, “resolution”, and “seed”, with code-plants growing in lime green (#ecf874) pots. The bee has a yellow body with dark brown stripes, black oval eyes, pink rectangular blush cheeks, a small smile, and rounded translucent light-blue wings; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow and a warm cream garden-workshop background.
